goal: Sign on, find the member by member number (parameter member_number), open their record and click Update Member Information. Set the e-mail, phone and mailing address from parameters email, phone and address, and save. Report the member name and a confirmation that the update was accepted. Before emitting, deliberately submit an invalid e-mail and an invalid phone so you can read the app's real rejection wording, and declare a flow-level business outcome that detects it with a detail locator on the specific reason. Also declare a flow-level business outcome for no matching member.
